skill.name: project-health
skill.desc: Audit projects in dev roots for LLXML compliance and structural health.
skill.overview: Scan dev directories for projects and check they follow LLXML conventions. Reports missing structure, outdated formats, and inconsistencies.
skill.when_to_use: - Periodic health checks across all projects - After migrating a project to LLXML format - When onboarding a new project - Before major work to ensure clean state

checks.required:
These must exist for a project to be LLXML-compliant:
- `ll.xml` at project root (manifest with name, desc, type) - `main/` directory (git repository) - `META/` directory - `META/profiles/` with at least one profile - `META/spec/` with at least one spec file
checks.recommended:
These should exist for full workflow support:
- `META/tickets/{todo,in-progress,review,done}/` - `META/inbox/` (flat directory, frontmatter-driven state) - `META/retro/` (flat directory, frontmatter-driven state) - `META/profiles/` (Saddle compilation profiles) - `META/logs/`
checks.warnings:
Flag these as needing attention:
- Old-format files in META root (PLAN.md, OBJECTIVES.md, TODO.md, etc.) - Objectives directory (should use tickets) - Old mail directory structure (META/mail/{inbox,read,trash}/) - Missing stable/ branch for libraries - Stale worktrees (underscore dirs with no matching in-progress ticket)

skill.output_format:
``` PROJECT HEALTH REPORT =====================
~/dev/apps/xdoc/ [OK] ll.xml [OK] main/ [OK] META/profiles/ [OK] META/spec/xdoc.xml [OK] META/tickets/ [OK] META/inbox/ [WARN] Stale worktree: _b/ (no matching ticket)
~/dev/apps/ramble/ [MISSING] ll.xml [MISSING] META/ctx/kickoff.xml [WARN] Old format: META/PLAN.md [WARN] Old format: META/OBJECTIVES.md
Summary: 2 projects scanned, 1 compliant, 1 needs migration ```
skill.steps: 1. Identify dev roots to scan (configured in Saddle or passed as argument) 2. For each directory with main/ or .git/: - Check for ll.xml - Check META/ structure - Check for old-format files - Check for stale worktrees 3. Generate report grouped by project 4. Summarize compliance status
skill.script:
```bash #!/bin/bash # Quick health check - run from dev root or pass path
check_project() { local dir="$1" local name=$(basename "$dir") local issues=0
echo -e "\n$dir/"
# Required [[ -f "$dir/ll.xml" ]] && echo " [OK] ll.xml" || { echo " [MISSING] ll.xml"; ((issues++)); } [[ -d "$dir/main" ]] && echo " [OK] main/" || { echo " [MISSING] main/"; ((issues++)); } [[ -d "$dir/META/profiles" ]] && echo " [OK] META/profiles/" || { echo " [MISSING] META/profiles/"; ((issues++)); } [[ -d "$dir/META/spec" ]] && echo " [OK] META/spec/" || { echo " [MISSING] META/spec/"; ((issues++)); }
# Recommended [[ -d "$dir/META/tickets" ]] && echo " [OK] META/tickets/" || echo " [INFO] META/tickets/ not set up" [[ -d "$dir/META/inbox" ]] && echo " [OK] META/inbox/" || echo " [INFO] META/inbox/ not set up" [[ -d "$dir/META/retro" ]] && echo " [OK] META/retro/" || echo " [INFO] META/retro/ not set up" [[ -d "$dir/META/profiles" ]] && echo " [OK] META/profiles/" || echo " [INFO] META/profiles/ not set up"
# Warnings - old format for old in PLAN.md OBJECTIVES.md TODO.md BLUEPRINTS.md; do [[ -f "$dir/META/$old" ]] && { echo " [WARN] Old format: META/$old"; ((issues++)); } done [[ -d "$dir/META/objectives" ]] && { echo " [WARN] Old format: META/objectives/"; ((issues++)); }
return $issues }
# Scan root="${1:-.}" echo "PROJECT HEALTH REPORT" echo "====================="
compliant=0 total=0
for dir in "$root"/*/; do [[ -d "$dir/main" || -d "$dir/.git" ]] || continue ((total++)) check_project "${dir%/}" [[ $? -eq 0 ]] && ((compliant++)) done
echo -e "\nSummary: $total projects scanned, $compliant compliant, $((total-compliant)) need attention" ```
skill.integration: Can be run: - Manually via the script above - As part of a harness that watches dev roots - On session start to surface projects needing migration
